review.headline: Long run done as planned: 18.6 km at 5:52/km, steady and within the easy range.
observations: Distance matched the plan exactly (18.6 km) and avg pace of 5:52/km sits inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy band.
Splits were very even at 5:52/km per km, and HR stayed in a tight 144-148 bpm band, so the pacing was controlled.
Avg HR 146 is 3 bpm above the 11-15 long run (143 at 5:50/km), and efficiency dropped from 1.200 to 1.169.
flags: Efficiency is down about 3% on the previous long run, with HR up at a similar pace; worth watching alongside the load.
ATL 65.9 is well above CTL 49.2 after the week, with TSB at -0.7.
Week 3 completed 4 of 7 sessions, with no strength or cross-training done.
No RPE or athlete note was logged, so effort perception is unknown.
